//: Owned by Recoder. The BUILD tsconfig used by tsup's .d.ts emit. It exists because @recoder/connectors ships multiple entry roots: the foundation (src/index.ts) PLUS the five typecheck-clean per-channel adapters under social-gateways/*/(connector|adapter)/index.ts. The package-root tsconfig.json pins rootDir=src and excludes social-gateways/ (raw reference source that does not compile in isolation); declaration emit across the adapter entries therefore needs a config that (a) drops the single src rootDir and (b) includes only the five clean adapter subtrees alongside src. This is NOT a type-error escape hatch: each adapter already type-checks clean against the foundation via its own scoped tsconfig (social-gateways/<ch>/(connector|adapter)/tsconfig.json). The known-broken discord adapter and the not-yet-extracted line/feishu adapters are intentionally excluded.
